question: Does the whole registered resident recovery distinguish episodic pre-CPU activity from a persistent baseline better than late20 or P50?
ablation: FULL_MEAN: use whole registered pre mean power without CPU. Separately report whether any gain belongs to longer power observation rather than CPU information.
window: All complete5s bins from ceil(registered recovery_start relative to target/5)*5 through30. Discard only leading partial bin<5s, not outcome-selected dates or temperatures. Conditioning96 fully lane-released before start.
persistent_CPU_proxy: Time-weighted median other CPU rate over same registered pre. Operational robust location for episodic activity; not certified latent persistent state, future CPU level or physical CPU energy.
fit: One nonnegative within-session pre-only power/CPU slope with equal session weights. Hold gap30/180 blocks out then final development6: exactly3 global fits. All widths, median, horizon and constraints fixed; no threshold or family search.
candidate_baseline: P_full_mean + b*(median other_CPU - mean other_CPU). Existing fixed p4 unchanged. Applies only35..120; keep original P50 accounting0..35. Nonpositive power unsupported, no clipping.
evaluation: Development6 opposite-gap estimates; all already viewed confirmation6 final development-only slope. Same0..120/future35..120/work/post-lane idle windows; no random sample splits. Show all worsening and feature extrapolation, no confirmation-based selection.
prediction_layer: Actual lane schedule conditional cost only; not arrival-to-response end-to-end validation. Pre event cutoff30, hypothetical issue35, horizon120; CSV export is post-session and live delivery not implemented.
outcome_rule: Report errors and finite evidence; no fabricated accuracy PASS, policy ranking or automatic default/RL/strict change. CPU slope/median not physical cause identification. If mean-only improves and CPU does not, attribute gain to observation, not CPU.
AP: Keep all existing AP coefficients, initialization results and energy proxy unchanged.
preservation: Frozen coefficients, prior candidates, raw/FAIL/terminated plans and other RL/user work read-only; separate ID/output; experiment_ready=false.
posthoc: Family chosen after prior results were viewed; future outcomes of these sessions are already seen. New feature extraction does not make this a fresh blind confirmation.
